programs.description: A man borrows money to fund his sibling's overseas education. However, trouble ensues when his brother returns home and discloses an unexpected truth.
When the son of a widowed father collapses, he gets taken to the hospital for a detailed diagnosis. However, their lives turn topsy-turvy when the child starts communicating with a mysterious nurse.
